$schema.description: Reference to the JSON Schema file that validates this data file.

Android.description: Android guest configuration. Required when type is Android; forbidden for every other type. All inner properties are required.

gsiImage.description: GSI image filename under src/<type>/ (e.g. src/Android/GSI.img).

gappsUrl.description: MindTheGapps zip download URL for sideloading Google apps onto LineageOS (e.g. https://github.com/MindTheGapps/16.0.0-arm64/releases/download/.../MindTheGapps-16.0.0-arm64-....zip).

magiskUrl.description: Magisk APK download URL for boot-image patching and guest install (official GitHub releases only).

gsiUrl.description: Android GSI system image download URL (gsi_gms_arm64, includes Google Mobile Services). Null means no GSI disk — boot Lineage only and sideload gappsUrl instead. When set, use a URL from https://developer.android.com/topic/generic-system-image/releases.

systemImage.description: System image filename under src/<type>/ (e.g. src/Android/system image.qcow2).

userdataImage.description: Userdata image filename under data/ (writable runtime disk).

diskSize.description: Boot disk size as a suffixed size string matching the size grammar (^[0-9]+ ?(kB|MB|GB|TB|kiB|MiB|GiB|TiB)$). Decimal prefixes (kB/MB/GB/TB) are canonical in manifest values; binary prefixes (kiB/MiB/GiB/TiB) are accepted input. KB and KiB (capital K) are invalid.

hosts.description: Hosts where this VM should be provisioned.

id.description: Unique machine identifier used in file paths, UUID/MAC derivation, and CLI selection. UUID/MAC derivation is a pure SHA-256 function of this value (see src/modules/lib/vm-identity.nix).

macAddressPrefix.description: MAC address prefix used to derive the guest NIC address.

macOS.description: macOS guest configuration. Required when type is macOS; forbidden for every other type. All inner properties are required.

minImageSize.description: Minimum prebuilt disk image size accepted during provisioning, as a suffixed size string matching the size grammar (^[0-9]+ ?(kB|MB|GB|TB|kiB|MiB|GiB|TiB)$). Decimal prefixes (kB/MB/GB/TB) are canonical in manifest values; binary prefixes (kiB/MiB/GiB/TiB) are accepted input. KB and KiB (capital K) are invalid.

hostPort.description: Host-side TCP port in the nucleus VM forward block (22000-22099).

ram.description: RAM size as a suffixed size string matching the size grammar (^[0-9]+ ?(kB|MB|GB|TB|kiB|MiB|GiB|TiB)$). Decimal prefixes (kB/MB/GB/TB) are canonical in manifest values; binary prefixes (kiB/MiB/GiB/TiB) are accepted input. KB and KiB (capital K) are invalid.

sound.description: UTM guest audio hardware. "none" disables the guest sound card (empty Sound array) — the workaround for the UTM SPICE audio teardown deadlock (see .agents/instructions/vm-management.instructions.md).

Windows.description: Windows guest configuration. Required when type is Windows; forbidden for every other type. All inner properties are required (isoUrl is nullable).

isoUrl.description: Windows ISO download URL. Null means auto-resolve via Mido/Fido.
